createAccount.noteContent: This invitation is valid for 7 days. If it expires, please ask the person who invited you to send a new invitation.
createAccount.platformInfo: This platform allows you to review and complete Biosphere Reserve nomination dossiers and periodic review submissions.
createAccount.steps.1: Create your account using the link below. Please ensure you register with the same email address that received this invitation.
createAccount.steps.2: Validate your account by clicking the confirmation link sent to you.
createAccount.steps.3: Log in using your account credentials. We recommend bookmarking the login page for future access.
